  • 2026/05Our paper Rapid and Physically-Based Gaussian Splatting of Unknown Space Objects in Low Earth Orbit has been accepted for a spotlight talk for the From Sea to Space: Advancing Perception in Harsh Domains workshop at ICRA 2026. See you in Vienna, Austria! :austria:
  • 2025/09Our paper Improved 3D Gaussian Splatting of Unknown Spacecraft Structure Using Space Environment Illumination Knowledge has been accepted at 2025 International Conference on Space Robotics (iSpaRo). See you in Sendai, Japan! :jp:
  • 2025/09Our paper Bridging the Domain Gap for Flight-Ready Spaceborne Vision has been accepted to Journal of Spacecraft and Rockets!
  • 2025/04Our paper Robust Multi-Task Learning and Online Refinement for Spacecraft Pose Estimation across Domain Gap, published in the 2024/06 issue of Advances in Space Research, received the 2024 COSPAR Outstanding Paper Award for Young Scientists!
  • 2024/07I started working as a GN&C engineer at Nara Space Technology Inc. in Seoul, South Korea. :kr:
  • 2024/06My Ph.D. thesis Robust machine learning for vision-based navigation about non-cooperative resident space objects is now available online!
  • 2024/04Our paper Satellite Pose Estimation Challenge: Dataset, Competition Design, and Results, published in the 2020/10 issue of the IEEE Transactions on Aerospace and Electronic Systems, received the M. Barry Carlton Award!
  • 2024/01Our paper Online Supervised Training of Spaceborne Vision during Proximity Operations using Adaptive Kalman Filtering has been accepted to ICRA 2024!
